title: eval-toolkit OOD Manifest (v1)
description: Schema for the YAML manifest consumed by eval_toolkit.loaders.ood_dataset_from_manifest. Declarative loading of multiple OOD eval slates (BIPIA, AgentDojo, InjecAgent, NotInject, PINT, LLMail-Inject, etc.) into a single unified DataFrame. Closes eval-toolkit#48.

name.description: Optional manifest-level dataset name (used as describe() fallback).

description.description: Optional manifest-level description (used as describe() fallback).

license.description: Optional SPDX license identifier for the aggregate manifest.

slices.description: Mapping of {slice_id: slice_spec}. Each slice becomes one batch of rows in the output DataFrame with source=<slice_id>.

url.description: HTTP(S) URL or local file path (file:// or bare) to the source file. Bytes are sha256-verified against the 'sha256' field before reading.

sha256.description: Expected sha256 of the source bytes. Either bare 64-char hex or 'sha256:<hex>'. Mismatch raises ValueError at load time.

format.description: File format. If omitted, inferred from the URL's extension.

text_field.description: Column name in the source file that contains the text. Defaults to 'text'.

label_field.description: Column name in the source file that contains the label. Defaults to 'label'.

label_map.description: Optional mapping from source label values to ints (e.g. {clean: 0, injected: 1}). If omitted, labels are cast directly to int.

sample_size.description: Optional row sub-sample size. null (or omitted) = all rows. If set, 'seed' is required.

seed.description: Random seed for sub-sampling. Required if sample_size is set.
